Approval

uh-PROO-vuhl · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Approval is official agreement that something is acceptable or good.

The students waited for the librarian's approval before hanging their posters.

Worked Example

The city gave its approval, so the new skate park can finally be built.

The city officially said yes to the skate park. That official yes is called approval.

How Approval Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

permission

permission: being allowed to do something

acceptance

acceptance: being taken as good enough

Antonyms

rejection

rejection: a no; being turned down

disapproval

disapproval: thinking something is wrong or bad

How Strong Is It? — Acceptance → approval → Praise

Acceptance vs. approval

Acceptance vs. approval: Acceptance is milder: the club's acceptance just means you are allowed in.

Praise vs. approval

Praise vs. approval: Praise is stronger: the judges did not just give her dance their approval - they praised it in front of everyone.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — approv

root — approv: to approve, to say yes to (Latin (approbare))

suffix — al

suffix — al: the act or result of (builds a noun here) (Latin)

Put it together

Put it together: Approve means to say yes, and here -al builds a noun: approval is the act of saying yes.

Use the root in a new word: approve

Word Choice

Watch the suffix here: -al usually builds describing words, but in approval it builds a noun - the act of approving. You will see -al building nouns again in festival and journal.
